analysis: The map image is oriented with the main entrance (Ngọ Môn / Lối vào) at the bottom and the North Gate (Cửa Hòa Bình) at the top. Geographically, the Imperial City of Hue is rotated approximately 37 degrees counter-clockwise from North-Up (its main axis runs from Southeast to Northwest). Therefore, in this image, North points towards the top-right (at about 37-45 degrees clockwise from vertical). To overlay this image correctly in Leaflet, you have two options: 1) Use the standard axis-aligned bounding box (SW and NE) provided below, but note that the image must be rotated to align with the real world. 2) Use a rotated image overlay plugin (like Leaflet.ImageOverlay.Rotated) with the three corner coordinates: Top-Left [16.47039, 107.57258], Top-Right [16.47554, 107.57923], and Bottom-Left [16.46369, 107.57711].
